description: A notes app that looks done in the browser it was built in, breaks the README's three promises everywhere else, and runs any note that is HTML.

defects.tell: notes live only in an in-memory array; one reload loses them all, against the README's 'saved automatically'
linkify() builds HTML from the note text and render() assigns it to innerHTML, so a note like runs script in the page; once notes are saved, it runs on every visit
Export calls window.showSaveFilePicker with no feature detection; Safari and Firefox do not have it, so Export cannot work there
every export failure, including the person cancelling the save dialog, becomes alert('Something went wrong') with no cause and no next step
.toolbar has width: 560px, so a 320 px phone scrolls sideways (document 592 px wide)
*:focus { outline: none } with no replacement, so a keyboard user cannot see where they are
loads lodash from a CDN that app.js never uses: a third-party request and a failure point that buy nothing
with no notes the list renders nothing at all; a first-time visitor sees a blank page under the toolbar

control.tell: dark mode is done right: color-scheme plus a prefers-color-scheme block redefining the same tokens. A report that flags the theme is inventing.
